priority.override_reason: Brief 07 selects a descriptor-complete shared receiver-layout absence proof for trees and cdjs. Coding base is 95c3af21, containing the preceding OwnSlot leaf. Explicit queue fallback preserves the e54 sealed evidence; supplemental isolated screens compare exactly against 95c3af21.

mechanism.summary: Cache the complete ordered own string-key layout with each data descriptor flag, retaining interned key identities. Guard absence across ordinary receivers by complete live layout equality rather than receiver identity, plus current prototype, middle-chain revision/identity and holder revision/live data slot. Use the existing hinted bounds-miss dispatch to an out-of-line prototype reader only after sharing is established; preserve original hot routes for single receivers. No per-object name map or global interning table. Lookup boundary: bytecode/named_property_cache.rs and new child proof module; compact_fn/property.rs; bytecode/vm_props.rs; value/object/slot_reads.rs plus new layout child and value/object.rs deletion-history metadata in existing cold storage; focused tests. No executor, closure/capture, class-field, typed_loop, vm_bindings, Date, concat, activation ABI or linker-order edits.
mechanism.generality: Every site whose name is absent in a complete eligible ordinary compact layout may reuse that absence for receivers with the same shared names and descriptor bits. Every added/shadowing key or descriptor change breaks complete equality. Dictionary storage, deleted-property receivers, accessors and exotic receivers decline sharing. This is a layout value proof, checked structurally; constructor objects currently have shared names, not canonical descriptor-complete shape ids. No source/benchmark matching. Snapshot comparison remains O(field count), bounded by existing compact storage admission; no assumed 320-instruction removal. Frozen target ceiling 0.99 requires at least 1% whole-case cycles improvement, all pairs improving: the supplied ideal lookup budget is about 4.8% whole-tree and 1.8% whole-CDjs instructions before complete-layout checking, so 0.95 would exceed CDjs reach. Controls must stay below 1.03 on both instructions and cycles.
semantic_risks: Every receiver key and descriptor must be checked; count-only, epoch-only and one-key proofs are unsound
Adding an instance method or middle prototype accessor/data property must decline before reading the holder
Holder value writes must remain visible; structural mutation and setPrototypeOf invalidate by live guards
Proxy, module namespace, typed-array, String-wrapper and array exotic receivers never share; dynamic/deleted objects decline
Keep probe and executors from growing. Cycle-only control failures with unchanged instructions are placement; report offsets/sizes without spending an attempt or re-pinning
